posts.text:
CNBC just noted that half of Under Armour's profit is coming from tariff refunds, and that broadly the refunds are propping up corporate profits.

Weird those refunds aren't going to consumers. Also weird prices aren't coming down. Almost as if tariffs don't drive inflation.

What's funny about this tweet is that to address it I first have to explain that this guy is Trump's main antitrust enforcer. No one knows who he is otherwise.

The populist right came into office talking big, but are now irrelevant. Lina Khan is well-known, these guys aren't.
